w8_01_baseline_vs_final.title: Final model compared with baseline
w8_01_baseline_vs_final.interp: Every option sits on the chance line: the final candidate scores 0.529 (interval 0.47–0.59), the best refinement 0.537, and the transparent RiskScore rule 0.520 (0.49–0.54). None approaches the required 0.65. The final model is therefore retained only as a tested integration fixture, not as a decision tool.
